question_text: A 50-year-old man with acute myeloid leukemia undergoes multiple chemotherapeutic regimens but does not enter remission. His oncologist suggests that he enroll in a trial for a new medication that causes intercalation of DNA during the G2 phase of the cell cycle. Which of the following anti-cancer agents is this new agent most similar to?
